ventures.name: Fasteners Trading

ventures.name: AI & Software Development

about.info:
I am an alumnus of the esteemed Al-Jamea-tus-Saifiyah, where we were taught the virtue of Rasulullah (S.A.W.): “A person’s craft is their treasure.” That principle has guided me ever since.

Today I live in Dubai, UAE, where I run a fasteners trading business and work as an AI and software developer, building web apps, portals and automation tools. I believe tools are only part of the process; the real value of any craft lies in the creativity and vision of the craftsman.
